trial_rationale: Five independent server lifecycles are a finite pilot budget, not a power calculation or statistical-significance claim. Same binary/config/UUID; no small/big, ablation, comparator or randomized treatment.
ceiling_resolution: New v2 case raises ceiling10 to12 explicitly: 4+1+2+5=12. Historical case-middle.json and run_middle.py remain frozen. No truncation or hidden requests.
deadlines: Absolute, non-sliding monotonic deadlines. Each request gets min(120, remaining480, remaining target/outer/pilot budget), never a fresh480. 480 is an aggregate cutoff, not a promise of12*120; unfinished issued requests are censored and the remainder unissued. Target lifetime includes startup/request/bookkeeping; shutdown is additional. Supervisor helper overhead reserves5s handshake+5s command+8s wait grace+8s cancel wait+2s helper reap. Outer deadline closes admission; existing authenticated custodian retains cleanup authority.

planning_estimate.interpretation: About1h scheduling allowance: ~18min extrapolated HTTP cost plus~42min conservative startup/idle/observation/shutdown allowance. Not measured current-binary cost; observed historical startup18.497s. Literal worst-case envelope2h. Abort at fixed deadlines; do not add trials to compensate failures.

primary_outcomes: Client-observed measured-QA TTFT (first nonempty SSE content, not token boundary) and request_e2e_seconds, with all25 scheduled slots and failure/censoring counts
Per-request serialized log-byte-window mixed_decoder_invocation logical checkpoint_read_calls and checkpoint_read_bytes; startup excluded and separately retained
Per-request expert_hits, expert_uploads and expert_evictions; hit share only hits/(hits+uploads) when nonzero, explicitly not a universal cache-hit probability or miss counter
Facade h2d_copies/h2d_bytes and artifact_uploads/artifact_upload_bytes, not physical PCIe traffic
Sampled owner-bound GPU/tree PSS high water and raw resource_shutdown_summary evidence/coverage; no exact peak, hard-host-cap or universal final-release claim
physical_io_outcome: Timestamp-bracketed raw Linux NFS client mountstats before/after startup, each request, request phase and shutdown, selected by longest checkpoint-path mount. Report shared-mount serverreadbytes and READ RPC deltas only with stable boot/mount namespace/device/mount/statvers/age and monotone counters. Missing/reset samples stay null. Shared-client traffic cannot be attributed to this server; physical NAS backend disk/network bytes remain unknown.
denominators: All5 lifecycles,60 requests,25 measured QA stay scheduled. For each phase retain success,failed,censored,unissued; issued=success+failed+censored,terminal=success+failed. Lost/incomplete issued outcomes are censored with explicit reason, never unissued or success. Startup/quality/custody STOP leaves subsequent slots unissued, no replacement. Quality and metric eligibility separate from HTTP success. Descriptive per-lifecycle rows and eligible distributions only, with scheduled denominators alongside; no CI/p-value/power/steady-state/speedup claim.

stop_policy.unknown_custody: STOP admission and all subsequent lifecycles immediately on PID/birth/parent/UUID identity loss, unauthenticated or unknown descendant drain, known foreign GPU owner, explicit unknown physical scope/quarantine/fence/closure, pending final close or quarantine. Never repair by exit, idle, Drop, retries, fabricated zeros or foreign signals.
stop_policy.other_failures: STOP on startup/request timeout, failed HTTP/text/usage/actual-ID gate, unavailable required trace/counter window, mount sampling failure/reset or missing required owner-close identity/quiescence, changed pins/argv/quality, or failed pre/post idle. Preserve distinct reasons and all planned slots.
stop_policy.resource_unverified: Unsupported resource partitions and final release may remain unobserved, not unknown custody. A complete owner-local close with actual closed/quiescent, retained residency, zero observed pending uploads/unknown bytes, original scoped identity, process normal exit, authenticated drain and independent post-idle can permit progression. Do NOT require universal post-Drop/final release or zero retained source mappings/allocator residency. Preserve resource_contract_complete=unverified and raw evidence qualifiers.

logging.privacy: Explicit opt-in token IDs/raw SSE can reconstruct output; raw mountstats can expose export paths. Restrict artifacts to approved local custody, no remote upload; do not dump prompts beyond frozen public canaries, arbitrary env or secrets.
logging.cost: DEBUG/TRACE, sampler and raw capture overhead is unmeasured and all results instrumented. Flush/drain/parse log after shutdown; no claimed uninstrumented baseline. A new matching baseline build/quality seal is required, never reuse historical n1 numerics.

custody.gpu_policy: No GPU query, lock, HTTP, process/server launch in CPU preparation. Future coordinator requires renewed sole-owner grant, one physical UUID bound to ordinal0, local nonblocking UUID lock, authenticated launch_guard/subreaper, birth-bound observation, pre/post all-eight idle. Locks are local, NOT global GPU/NFS reservations.
custody.page_cache: uncontrolled; separate lifecycles are not storage-cold or independent NFS/page-cache samples
